observations.observation: CDE current Comprehensive School Safety Plans page recommends informing parents in languages they understand of reunification arrangements and establishing reunification locations and procedures. Retrieved text supports the limited stated use, not local school-specific implementation.

CDC chemical-emergency evacuation page (dated June 10, 2026) says do not go to separated children or loved ones unless local authorities say it is safe. Hazard-specific advice; not a universal instruction for all reunifications.
CDC reunification page (dated October 25, 2024) recommends emergency contacts, multiple meeting places and contact cards for children. Original source does not authorize this draft tool for release.

The retrieved Colorado Office of School Safety reunification page is a resource index and describes an Adams 14 video urging parents to wait for instructions. No photo ID, pen or limit-calls instruction was found in retrieved page text; those details in the register require independent source confirmation.

NCMEC CyberTipline page shows its 24-hour hotline and directs reports of missing children or suspected exploitation, but the page is primarily about online child exploitation rather than emergency-family reunification. Limit claim to hotline existence pending reviewer choice of more context-appropriate source.
